SearchTracesByPage.description_zh: 分页查询调用链列表信息，可根据时间、应用名称、IP地址、Span名称和Tag等信息筛选调用链

SendTTSVerifyLink.description_en: Sends a text message to an alert contact to verify the mobile number of the alert contact
SendTTSVerifyLink.description_zh: 为告警联系人发送手机号码验证短信

SetRetcodeShareStatus.description_en: Turns on or turns off logon-free sharing for an application monitored by Browser Monitoring
SetRetcodeShareStatus.description_zh: 打开或关闭前端监控站点的免登录分享开关，打开该功能后即可通过调用GetRetcodeShareUrl接口获取的地址访问前端监控页面

StartAlert.description_en: Invoke the StartAlert API to start an alert rule.
StartAlert.description_zh: 调用StartAlert接口启动报警规则

StopAlert.description_en: Call StartAlert to stop an alert rule
StopAlert.description_zh: 调用StartAlert接口停止报警规则

SwitchSyntheticTaskStatus.description_en: Starts or stops a scheduled synthetic monitoring task
SwitchSyntheticTaskStatus.description_zh: 启动或者停止定时拨测任务

SyncRecordingRules.description_en: Batch synchronizes the aggregation rules of a cluster to other target clusters across all regions
SyncRecordingRules.description_zh: 将某个集群的聚合规则批量同步到全Region的其他目标集群

TagResources.description_zh: 用于给ARMS资源实例打标签

UninstallManagedPrometheus.description_en: Uninstalls a managed Prometheus agent for a serverless Kubernetes (ASK) cluster, Distributed Cloud Container Platform for Kubernetes (ACK One) cluster, or Elastic Compute Service (ECS) cluster

UntagResources.description_zh: 用于删除ARMS资源实例标签

UpdateAlertContact.description_zh: 调用UpdateAlertContact接口更新报警联系人

UpdateAlertContactGroup.description_zh: 调用UpdateAlertContactGroup接口更新报警联系人分组

UpdateAlertRule.description_en: You can invoke the UpdateAlertRule API to update an alert rule
UpdateAlertRule.description_zh: 调用UpdateAlertRule接口更新报警规则

UpdateDispatchRule.description_zh: 调用UpdateDispatchRule接口修改分派策略

UpdateEnvCustomJob.description_en: Updates a custom job for an environment

UpdateEnvDropMetricsRule.description_en: Updates a discarded metric rule in the environment
UpdateEnvDropMetricsRule.description_zh: 更新环境中废弃指标规则

UpdateEnvPodMonitor.description_en: Updates the PodMonitor of an environment

UpdateEnvServiceMonitor.description_en: Updates the ServiceMonitor of an environment

UpdateEnvironment.description_en: Updates the configuration of an environment

UpdateGrafanaWorkspace.description_en: Updates the information about a Grafana workspace

UpdateGrafanaWorkspaceVersion.description_en: Updates the version of a Grafana workspace

UpdateIntegration.description_en: Modifies the information about an integration

UpdateMetricDrop.description_en: Updates the list of discarded metrics

UpdatePrometheusGlobalView.description_en: Updates the data sources of Prometheus instance for GlobalView
UpdatePrometheusGlobalView.description_zh: 更新Prometheus for GlobalView聚合数据源

UpdatePrometheusInstance.description_en: Updates the information of a Prometheus instance

UpdatePrometheusIntegration.description_en: Modifies the configurations of an exporter that is integrated into a Prometheus instance for Container Service or a Prometheus instance for ECS
UpdatePrometheusIntegration.description_zh: 更改Prometheus实例（仅支持aliyun-cs、ecs两种类型的实例）集成中心Exporter配置

UpdatePrometheusMonitoring.description_en: Updates the monitoring configuration of a Prometheus instance

UpdatePrometheusMonitoringStatus.description_en: Updates the status of the monitoring configuration of a Prometheus instance
UpdatePrometheusMonitoringStatus.description_zh: 更新Prometheus实例监控配置状态

UpdateRumApp.description_en: Updates a Real User Monitoring (RUM) application

UpdateRumFileStatus.description_en: Updates the status of a Real User Monitoring (RUM) file. You can call this operation after the RUM file is uploaded
UpdateRumFileStatus.description_zh: 更新RUM文件状态，上传RUM文件成功后，调用此接口

UpdateTimingSyntheticTask.description_en: Updates a scheduled synthetic test task

UpdateWebhook.description_en: Modifies the information about a webhook alert contact
UpdateWebhook.description_zh: 调用UpdateWebhook接口修改Webhook告警联系人信息

UpgradeAddonRelease.description_en: Updates the release information of an add-on

UpgradeEnvironmentFeature.description_en: Updates the feature information of an environment

Upload.description_en: Uploads a SourceMap file to ARMS Browser Monitoring
